environment.description: Kubernetes cluster running the CI/CD pipeline plugin as a Deployment in the 'ci-plugins' namespace. The service is exposed via a ClusterIP Service on port 8080. Build runners in the 'build-runners' namespace communicate directly with the plugin over the pod network. No service mesh is deployed. Network policies are set to allow-all. The plugin container runs with default securityContext (no memory limits enforced at cgroup level for the overflow scenario).

config.callers: build-runners namespace pods with direct network access
